_comment: Classic Macintosh housing spec, shared by scripts/build-mac-model.py (Blender generator for public/mac.glb) and MacintoshScene.tsx (CRT overlay fit). Dimensions in inches; `scale` converts to macGroup-local units so the picture is 0.72 tall with its centre at screenCenterLocal. Front face is vertical and faces +Z; the body is centred on x=0 / z=0.
